name: recordings_visual_identity_read
title: Read image identifications and application status
description: Reads saved exact-image answers, current native background work, capability limits and guarded recovery actions. Optional contextual image questions include source time, marked box, media evidence and a signed question_context. An answer responds to the actual evidence; raw examples are not a recognition-training checklist. include_questions false reads pending application status. A completed update does not establish identity throughout a Recording.

source_seconds.description: Retained marked images nearest this Recording time. Returned times are exact and can differ from the requested time.
